HOW TO PLAY

Pull back from Burg & release — like a slingshot — to launch him platform to platform.
You get one extra jump in mid-air — tap again while flying to use it. It refills the moment you land.
🖐️
Reach a wall to grab on and slide down slowly — then launch off toward the next platform. Great for big gaps.
Land on enemies from above to stomp them for points. Touch them any other way and it's over.
Watch for special tiles: kelp slows your next launch, bouncy supercharges it, crumbling ones break after you land.
☠️
The toxin below is always rising, and it speeds up the longer you climb. Don't let it catch you.
